title: The Salary Trap - Why The System Keeps You Broke
description:
Your salary was designed to keep you broke, not wealthy. No matter how many raises you get, lifestyle inflation, golden handcuffs, and paycheck-to-paycheck psychology are engineered to keep your expenses permanently chasing your income. This video exposes the exact mechanics of the salary trap: how debt, lifestyle creep, and the illusion of job security lock you into financial dependence, and the specific steps to attack the income-to-expense gap, redirect money into wealth-building assets, and break free from the system that profits from your predictability.
